title.narrative: Supporting the Ministry of Health in the Republic of Sudan with medicines for cancer patients and personal hygiene bags

description.narrative: A joint cooperation program was signed between the Center and the Kuwait Red Crescent Society. This program aims to support and empower the health sector in the Ministry of Health in the Republic of Sudan by providing (80) items of special cancer medicines and providing (1000) personal hygiene bags that were provided according to the mechanisms followed in the Center and launched and delivered to the Ministry of Health in Sudan in Port Sudan on May 27, 2024
Reducing critical cases and deaths resulting from lack of availability of necessary health services.
Support and empowerment of the health sector in the Republic of Sudan.
